01 — About

Dubai is my choice — and my suggestion to you

I don't sell square metres. I help people find a lifestyle — a home that matches who they are, and who they are becoming. That is why my page talks as much about mindset, calm and growth as it does about villas and towers.

From off-plan launches to ready homes, I work close to the developers shaping this city, and I only bring you what I genuinely believe in. Rare opportunities have to be recognised — and when the moment is right, moved on.

No noise, no pressure. Just honest guidance, in English and Persian, from first message to keys in hand.

— Nazanin Radaee
